versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "creditclaw-stripe" skill (v2.3.3), providing Stripe-powered agentic wallets.
- Enables easy bot/agent wallet top-up via Stripe/Link for purchases and A2A payments.
- Supports multiple payment rails: Encrypted Card (default), Stripe Wallet (x402, USDC), and Crossmint Wallet (coming soon).
- Emphasizes strong security: split-knowledge encryption, rate limiting, per-transaction approval, and real-time owner visibility.
- Detailed setup instructions and API references included for registration, permissions, storefronts, and transaction management.
